title: security(rbac-v2): enforce KMS region residency + audit logging hardening
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: customers in regulated environments require strict KMS residency guarantees and better auditability when RBAC v2 policies reference customer-managed keys. This PR implements enforcement for KMS region pinning at policy-evaluation time, surfaces KMS key residency in audit events, and hardens related RBAC v2 policy validation. Summary: (1) Add KMS region residency enforcement to the RBAC v2 policy enforcer so policies that declare 'kms_region_pin' are validated and enforced at request time; incompatible requests are rejected with a clear error and audit event. (2) Enhance audit logging to include KMS key ARN, region, and residency decision metadata so security teams can reconstruct decision paths. (3) Add integration tests and unit tests covering residency policy combinations, and add a migration check for existing policies that declare region pins. (4) Update docs and Helm values for Redwood Private so operators can configure allowed KMS regions and a policy enforcement toggle. Backwards compatibility: the enforcement is behind a runtime flag (rbac.v2.enforce_kms_residency) enabled by default for new installs; for upgrades the flag defaults to false and the migration CLI prints affected policies. Rollout plan: staged rollout to Dedicated clusters, feature-flagged in Private; monitoring added for reject-rate and audit volume. Risk & rollback: If enforcement causes unexpected rejects we can flip the runtime flag to false and rely on audit logs to identify offending policies. See linked linear items for product acceptance and compliance review.
